paragraphs:
# Chapter 2: Soils

Soil forms slowly from weathered rock
and living things over many years.

A soil profile has layers called horizons, from the topsoil down to the bedrock.

Clay soils hold water; sandy soils drain fast.

Farmers test their soil every few years.

Erosion can carry off topsoil in a single storm.
